def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cells={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==8}
    colmap={'F':1,'TL':2,'TR':4,'BL':3,'BR':5}
    cands=[]
    for i in range(H-1):
        for j in range(W-1):
            w=[(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)]
            n=sum(c in cells for c in w)
            if n not in (3,4): continue
            mn=('F' if n==4 else 'TL' if (i,j) not in cells else 'TR' if (i,j+1) not in cells else 'BL' if (i+1,j) not in cells else 'BR')
            cands.append((colmap[mn], w))
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def bt(rem):
        if not rem: return True
        cell=min(rem)
        cands=[c for c in cands if cell in set(c[1]) and set(c[1])<=rem]
        if not cands: return False
        # prefer larger windows, ties ordered by top-left
        cands.sort(key=lambda t: -len(t[1]))
        for col, w in cands:
            s=set(w)
            for a,b in w: res[a][b]=col
            if bt(rem-s): return True
            for a,b in w: res[a][b]=0
        return False
    ok=bt(set(cells))
    return ok, res
for n in (1,2,3):
    ok,res=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    r=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    same = ok and all(r[i][j]==res[i][j] for i in range(7) for j in range(7))
    print(n, ok, same)

def solve(gi):
    # 2x2 windows with >=3 blob cells; missing corner -> color, F -> color1
    colmap={'TL':2,'TR':4,'BL':3,'BR':5}
    def cands(gi):
        res=[]
        for i in range(len(gi)-1):
            for j in range(len(gi[0])-1):
                w=[(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)]
                ins=[p for p in w if gi[p[0]][p[1]]==8]
                if len(ins)==3 or len(ins)==4:
                    m=[p for p in w if p not in ins]
                    tag=None
                    if len(ins)==4: tag='F';col=1
                    elif len(m)==1:
                        om={ (i,j):'TL',(i,j+1):'TR',(i+1,j):'BL',(i+1,j+1):'BR'}[m[0]]
                        col=colmap[om]; tag=om
                    else: continue
                    res.append((col,tag,ins,m))
        return res
    cs=cands(gi)
    blob=[c for c in cs if c[3]==[]]  # full square pieces are the base colors? test which
    # hypothesis: each blob cell belongs to exactly one chosen window; window without 8s in missing = "filled piece" gets color; shared corners allowed.
    rem={(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==8}
    sol=None
    def bt(k):
        global sol
        if not rem and k<len(cs): return True
        if rem and k>=len(cs): return False
        # candidates covering smallest remaining cell
        cell=min(rem)
        pool=[c for c in cs if cell in set(c[2]) and (not c[3] or c[3]==[cell])]
        pool.sort(key=lambda t:min(t[2]))
        for col,tag,pts,m in pool:
            newrem=set(rem)-set(pts)
            if newrem and any(c[3]==list(newrem)[:1] for c in cs if False): pass
            ok=all(not(c['shar'] in newrem) for c in []) 
            if bt2(newrem,acc+[c]): return True
        return False
    acc=[]
    def bt2(rem,acc):
        nonlocal sol
        if not rem: return True
        cell=min(rem)
        pool=[c for c in cs if cell in set(c[2])]
        for col,tag,pts,m in sorted(pool,key=lambda t:min(t[2])):
            newrem=set(rem)-set(pts)
            shar_ok = all(c[3] not in newrem for c in acc)
            if shar_ok and bt2(newrem,acc+[ (col,pts) ]): return True
        return False
    ok=bt2(set(rem),[])
    out=[[0]*len(gi[0]) for _ in gi]
    for c in acc:
        col=cs.index(None) # placeholder
    return None

def solve(gi):
    P=pieces(gi); blob=set()
    for c in P: blob|=c[0]
    out=[[0]*len(gi[0]) for _ in gi]
    ok=True
    # try all subsets of P whose union covers blob exactly once per cell -> exact cover search
    sol=[None]
    def bt(rem,acc,cost):
        if not rem:
            sol[0]=list(acc); return True
        cell=min(rem)
        cand=[idx for idx,(ins,col) in enumerate(P) if cell in ins]
        seen={}; pool=[]
        for idx in cand:
            ins,col=P[idx]
            key=frozenset(sorted(ins))
            if key in seen: continue
            seen[key]=True; pool.append((key,ins,col,idx))
        pool.sort(key=lambda t:min(t[1]))
        for key,ins,col,idx in pool:
            if all(len(P[i][0]&ins)<=1 for i in acc):
                if bt(rem-ins,acc+[idx],cost+1): return True
        return False
    bt(blob,[],0)
    if sol[0] is None: return out
    for idx in sol[0]:
        ins,col=P[idx]
        for p in ins: out[p[0]][p[1]]=col
    return out
for n in (1,2,3):
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    print(n,o==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])

# Verify rule hypothesis: process 2x2 windows scanning top-left; a window with >=3 blob cells
# paints its blob cells with its color (L-tromino -> corner color, full square -> 1), later windows OVERWRITE.
def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bs={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==8}
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H-1):
        for j in range(W-1):
            ins=[p for p in [(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)] if p in bs]
            if len(ins)<3: continue
            miss=[p for p in [(i,j),(i,j+1),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)] if p not in bs]
            if not miss: col=1
            else:
                r,c=miss[0]
                col={'TL':2,'TR':4,'BL':3,'BR':5}[('TL' if r==i else ('TR' if r==i+1 else ('BL' if c==j else 'BR')))]
            for r,c in ins: out[r][c]=col
    return out
